name: epsilon
description: One op stream, Postgres to pixel — bun create blueshed/epsilon my-app. The runtime lives in your app: epsilon/, ~1.7k lines, tests included.

scripts.test: bun test epsilon/signal.test.ts epsilon/doc.test.ts epsilon/ui.test.ts epsilon/cli.test.ts
scripts.ci: bun run db:up && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:migrate && bun run test:pglite && bun run test:pg && bun run test:app; code=$?; bun run db:down; exit $code
